method: Source-first complete procedure contracts; exact text relocation and CP287 canonical row/node/scope crosswalk; historical B09-86–93 disposition matched by kind,id,span,operation, CP292 current complement. Historical context does not override current contracts. No independent full current AST replay.

groups.title: Two direction primary groups
groups.meaning: Opposite direction from chronology; current visibility.primary_groups retained by reference; recalculate opposite range then finalize opposite visibility using current signature without args. Assign opposite groups by reference. No new independent market.

groups.title: Full owner audit preparation
groups.meaning: Fixed owner iteration bullish then bearish. Direct E/S map indexing; accepted A source time set from eligible A excluding exact (source_time,int(source_index)) invalid identities. Source times dedup even if distinct indexes. Store accepted sets; prepare full audit with 0..len(candles)-1 and assign into each aliased group.

groups.title: Native commit callback
groups.meaning: Closure uses requested direction, not iterated owner; exact bullish selects register_primary_low else register_primary_high. Register first, then rebuild only that direction's full audit using retained accepted A set. No transactional rollback.

groups.title: Primary resolver and dispatch
groups.meaning: Construct NativePrimaryOrders once, groups by reference, on_high callback and requested direction. Exact bullish selects detect_bullish else bearish; E detector direct lookup. Non-null state.live_stages dispatches live.primary instead of native detect; native uses requested S/E/StopAll groups, chronology and resolver. Current production runner does not supply live continuation.

groups.title: Final label reconciliation and visible audit
groups.meaning: Select native main-side resolution and corresponding detector label method by exact bullish. Resolve through visible end, reconcile native audit labels. Capture required physical order_identity from existing visibility audit reaction First/Break without local conversion (native helper owns coercion), set dedup. Replace only visibility.prepared_order_audit with range bounds, detectors and accepted set plus required. No local catch.

groups.title: Direction range and visibility
groups.meaning: Calculate range then finalize with new signature excluding args; unconditional before primary gate. Uses shared state/timings.

groups.title: Primary owner gate
groups.meaning: Local primary None. getattr(args,direction,both)==both picks bearish; otherwise direct args.direction. Short-circuit requested direction match, primary module non-null, E map key present, explicit lifecycle path non-null. Timed PH/PL calls requested direction. No separate S flag here.

groups.title: Primary ownership and validation
groups.meaning: Store primary in shared state before native resolve_stopall_ownership. Replace visible StopAll list only; helper chooses physical source pair of main-side primary points through end, not historical removal. Validate existing prepared audit against displayed S/E/StopAll after ownership. Failures propagate, no rollback.

groups.title: Public direction output
groups.meaning: Serialize direction after conditional primary block; primary non-null merges native primary serialization into existing payload via update. No primary rerun. If earlier stage raises, no return.

groups.title: Group regimes
groups.meaning: Group direction by first occurrence, segment order retained. Exactly one segment returns original segment object (not copy and no calculationSegments addition).

groups.title: Aggregate list arrays
groups.meaning: Multiple segments: shallow copy last mapping, union keys having any list-valued occurrence using set (key iteration not explicitly stable). Concatenate per key in segment and row order, absent key defaults empty; present incompatible iterable can fail or yield unexpected shape. No dedup/sort, row refs retained.

groups.title: Bridge aggregation
groups.meaning: Collect bridgeOutput per segment absent default empty dict; any truthy enables separate merge. dict.fromkeys keys in first encounter order; rows concatenated by segment order, missing key empty. All-falsy leaves last segment's existing key/value as copied.

groups.title: Aggregate metadata
groups.meaning: Pop calculationEndTime only from aggregate; attach grouped original segment list as calculationSegments; return direction map. Last scalar metadata retained; historical segments not mutated by merge.

groups.title: Reversal initialization and independent selectors
groups.meaning: Initial current=market, incoming=None, opposite of target (exact bullish incl absent default => bearish, otherwise bullish). indexed_reaction depends on explicit closed_regime non-null, NOT selected resolver. If live non-null use live.closed_regime even if its value None, otherwise explicit closed_regime. No fallback from live None-valued resolver to explicit one.

groups.title: Fresh local calculation
groups.meaning: Shallow copy args then replace direction. Prepare fresh local state without live keyword if continuation None, else pass live; build direction output. Return group/state. No automatic reuse of active primary state.

groups.title: Publication index conversion
groups.meaning: absolute_payload_indexes creates fresh list/dict tree even offset zero; scalars unchanged. Start metadata only if offset differs from original market offset; non-null incoming assigned after projection as singleton transition already absolute. Incoming is closure read, not a captured default.

groups.title: Stopped segment publication
groups.meaning: Stop end from current reversal main candle timestamp (not exact event). Assign calculationEndTime and reversed-to-target status, overwrite each existing cycle status, clamp each existing leg cap with min. Missing arrays default empty; no null handling. Operates on projected copies.

groups.title: Reversal loop guard
groups.meaning: Resolve optional native release once; unconditional while True. Strict 0<boundary<len(current.candles) before prefix construction; invalid raises explicit RuntimeError. Not bounded by visible start/end here.

groups.title: Closed prefix boundaries
groups.meaning: Closure default captures current/boundary/direction; market_segment [0,boundary) excludes reversal candle, indexed_reaction option. has_history records visible start<=end. If absent visible history replace bounds with whole prefix for internal proof while retaining false flag. Construction/replacement before try.

groups.title: Independent prefix calculation and release
groups.meaning: Calculate without continuation, choose highs only exact bearish else lows, resolve through prefix full last index, return offset/first timestamp/original history flag/payload/confirmed points. Finally native release if non-null else live fallback when live non-null; errors propagate. No finally for pre-try construction failures.

groups.title: Optional cache and exact Primary3 proof
groups.meaning: If selected resolve_closed non-null call with direction/current/boundary/closure; else fresh prefix. Unpack five items. Always require any confirmed point number==3 then source_time==transition.high.source_time then price==transition.level; exact equality, no tolerance/extra index condition. Failure before publish, applies cached results too.

groups.title: Hidden prefix publication
groups.meaning: If no visible history recursively replace list values with empty list without visiting elements, recurse dict values preserving keys, leave other types unchanged. Still append stopped segment after projection and status handling; retained confirmed proof not emptied.

groups.title: New regime and transition ownership
groups.meaning: Read target, serialize incoming in old context (absolute offsets already applied), slice [boundary,len(current.candles)) includes reversal candle. Two independent exact target bootstrap flags (unknown target both false), same indexed_reaction selector. Assign current direction. No state carry from closed regime.

groups.title: Active regime dispatch and cleanup
groups.meaning: Try covers optional live.active_regime then fresh local calculate with continuation. Finally native release takes precedence else live fallback. Market_segment outside try; release failure may override result/body exception.

groups.title: Next reversal or finish
groups.meaning: Read optional state.primary_result.transition default None. If None or transition.index strictly > current.end_index publish active segment with absolute offset and first candle time and break; equality repeats. Return merge of encounter-order regimes. No partial fallback.
